description.invocation: One accumulated DDP training step (step() at gpt2_ddp_training.py:102-105) on each of 2 ranks: accumulate() runs 4 micro-batches of forward+backward on the fixed synthetic token inputs with DDP no_sync() on the first 3 and one gradient all-reduce, then optimizer.step() and torch.cuda.synchronize(). Weight reset (load_state_dict), serial reference construction, correctness checks, the 3 separately profiled diagnostic traces and report writing are measurement infrastructure, not the unit repeated by adapter.run().
notes: Command provenance (intent.json): torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=2 gpt2_ddp_training.py --output /tmp/original-ddp --profile; argparse defaults give warmup=2, repeats=5 and --workloads default workloads.json (common.py:21-31).

Diagnostic objective semantics (gpt2_ddp_training.py:121-125,156-157; common.py:87-105): 3 separately profiled invocations of the same step; per rank the sum of NCCL kernel durations is taken, then maximum across ranks per invocation, then the median of the 3 values. Mapped to the installed torch_communication collector field communication_kernel_sum_ms with rank_aggregation=max; collector availability is verified by the workload worker.

Caveat preserved verbatim in meaning from workloads.json communication_metric_caveat: the metric includes device waiting and is not wire time, critical-path time or exposed communication; it is profiled separately from clean step timing.

step_ms constraint preserves the source's clean-timing definition (gpt2_ddp_training.py:111-119,149-152): per-sample wall time of the full accumulated step with max across ranks, summarized as the median over repeats, with the Gloo control-group barrier outside the timed boundary; requirement is clean step <= 1.05x the same-command baseline (step_ms_max_baseline_ratio in workloads.json).

Discrete exact comparisons in addition to tolerances: every parameter gradient on all ranks must equal rank 0's broadcast copy exactly (torch.testing.assert_close atol=0.0, rtol=0.0 at gpt2_ddp_training.py:81-86); loss finiteness is asserted; a +1 corruption negative control must be rejected (common.py:79-84).

Preserved policies: FP32 weights, TF32 disabled and highest matmul precision (common.py:34-42), eager attention, deterministic seeds (model 20261020, inputs 31000+source_rank), SGD lr=0.001 momentum=0 weight_decay=0 foreach=False, DDP bucket_cap_mb=25, gradient_as_bucket_view=True, broadcast_buffers=False; baseline already uses no_sync accumulation (gpt2_ddp_training.py:36-45,59-61).

Effective batch = world_size 2 x micro_batch 1 x accumulation_steps 4 = 8, 1024 tokens per step; the 4 internal accumulation micro-batches are genuine workload iterations and stay inside the invocation; the exact-gradient replica check compares full DDP gradients against a serial single-GPU reference over the same global batch.

The separate allreduce-hook bucket inventory (logical bytes/call counts, gpt2_ddp_training.py:128-142) and trace kernel names are source-local diagnostics outside the installed collector fields and are not required_observations; no unavailable counters are requested.

No external assets: weights are deterministically seeded synthetic GPT-2 124M (make_model) and token IDs are seeded synthetic (make_inputs); deployment.box42.example.json lists no gpt2_ddp_training asset.

notes: Command provenance: intent.json command 'torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=2 gpt2_ddp_training.py --output /tmp/original-ddp --profile'; README.md:37 documents the equivalent 'python -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nproc-per-node=2' form.

Objective semantics: source metric diagnostic.max_rank_nccl_kernel_sum_ms = sum of device NCCL kernel durations per rank (torch.profiler kernel events with 'nccl' in the name, common.py:87-105), maximum across ranks per profiled invocation, median over the 3 separately profiled invocations (gpt2_ddp_training.py:156-157). It includes device waiting and is not wire time, exposed communication or a critical-path lower bound (workloads.json gpt2_ddp_training.communication_metric_caveat). It is mapped to the installed collector field torch_communication.communication_kernel_sum_ms with rank_aggregation=max and aggregation_order=ranks_then_samples; clean step timing and the diagnostic trace are separate invocations.

Constraint semantics: source notation step_ms_max_baseline_ratio=1.05 means the clean step time (per-repeat max across ranks, median of 5 repeats; gpt2_ddp_training.py:148-152, common.py:66-71) must stay <= 1.05x the original unmodified baseline of the same workload; README.md:48.

Discrete outputs requiring exact comparison: every parameter gradient on every rank must equal rank 0's broadcast replica exactly (torch.testing.assert_close with atol=0.0, rtol=0.0, checks.exact_gradient_replica_check, gpt2_ddp_training.py:81-86); the step loss must be finite (assert torch.isfinite(loss)); the negative control must reject a +1 corruption of reference gradients (common.py:79-84).

Numerical policy preserved: FP32 weights, TF32 disabled for matmul and cudnn, float32_matmul_precision 'highest' (common.py:34-42); eager attention, all dropout 0, use_cache=False (gpt2_ddp_training.py:26); SGD lr=0.001, momentum=0.0, weight_decay=0.0, foreach=False (gpt2_ddp_training.py:60); DDP broadcast_buffers=False, bucket_cap_mb=25, gradient_as_bucket_view=True (gpt2_ddp_training.py:59); effective batch = 2 ranks x 1 micro_batch x 4 accumulation_steps = 8, 1024 tokens per step.

State semantics: initial weights are snapshotted before measurement and restored via reset() (raw_model.load_state_dict(initial)) before every warmup step, timed repeat and profiled invocation; a Gloo control group performs barriers and record gathering outside the timed boundary (gpt2_ddp_training.py:53,97,113-115,123-124).
